Commentary.Commentary: It's time for the run chase to begin! The Sri Lankan players are spreading on the field. Out walk the dazzling duo of Prithvi Shaw and Shikhar Dhawan. The former set the stage on fire in the first ODI, are we in for something similar? Kasun Rajitha, who has replaced Isuru Udana in the XI, will bowl the first over. Done with the countdowns, here we go...

Right then, Sri Lanka have once again put the runs on the board and now will have to defend it against an in-form and hungry batting line-up of India. Surely, it's an under-par total but if the hosts manage to pick early wickets, we will be in for an entertaining chase. Do join us in a short while for all the action.

Main performers! With the bat, Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka again were among the runs while Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka and Chamika Karunaratne also scored more than 30 runs. But a big knock from a set batsman was lacking and that is something they need to work on. The Indian bowling wasn't impressive at the start and then at the end but they managed to gain control in the middle overs. Yuzvendra Chahal was the pick of the bowlers but his spin partner wasn't up to the mark with his lines and lengths. Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Deepak Chahar took 5 wickets between them but certainly, India would have been hoping for a much better show from them.

Powerplay 2 was more about India's comeback! After struggling to get the first breakthrough, the Indian team shifted to plan B of drying up the runs. They managed to do that successfully and in the 14th over Yuzvendra Chahal struck twice to peg Sri Lanka back. The going got quite tough for the hosts after that but the presence of a set Avishka Fernando and experienced Dhananjaya de Silva meant that they got yet another stand. However, in an attempt to take the attack to the bowlers to increase the scoring rate, both played rash shots and threw away their wickets in quick succession. Another couple of wickets went down before Powerplay 3 and the main feature was that every time there was a partnership, India managed to strike back.

Let's discuss Sri Lanka's batting innings in phases! They started safely in the first few overs of Powerplay 1 when the ball was moving around. Minod Bhanuka had a catch dropped in the second over but after that the Lankan openers put their head down and took on the Indian bowlers. There were plenty of boundaries scored in the first 10 overs as the home team finished that period wicket-less and the scorecard reading 59 runs. A happy and safe start!

80 runs in the last 10 overs and Sri Lanka have managed to better their last score by 13 runs. Once again Chamika Karunaratne showed his hitting prowess towards the end and played a handy cameo. His stand with Charith Asalanka was the main reason the hosts didn't lose the plot much and finished with a decent total on the board.

FOUR! Thumped down the ground and that is a superb end to the innings for Sri Lanka! THEY END WITH 275/9! This is full and on off, Karunaratne smashes it down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Smacked! This is full and outside off, Karunaratne smashes it wide of the sweeper cover fielder for a boundary.
That is what Rajitha does! On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Kasun Rajitha walks out to bat now!

OUT! Really good work from Ishan Kishan! This is short and outside off, Sandakan looks to drag it over the leg side but misses. He sets off for a bye but his partner stops after taking a start. Lakshan has to turn and get in but Kishan runs in and hits the stumps before that. Kishan says in Hindi and the stump mic catches it - 'Bol kar maara!' Meaning, he had said it before that he will do the run out. Last evening, he shared that he already had told his teammates that he will hit the first ball for a six in the first match. Love the confidence of these youngsters.
This time he goes after the wide one outside off, it goes on the bounce to the fielder at deep cover. One taken.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, Chamika Karunaratne lets it be. Wided.
Lakshan Sandakan walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Kumar has another one! The good thing for Sri Lanka is that the batters crossed. The idea was not wrong there by Chameera but the execution was not there. It is a slower one outside off. Chameera shuffles across and then looks to slog it over the leg side. He had to drag it, the bat turns in his hands and the ball balloons towards square leg off the top edge. Devdutt Padikkal (sub) moves back a bit to take the skier safely.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Devdutt Padikkal b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! The last two balls spoil the over completely and it turns out to be an excellent one for Sri Lanka! Poor ball to finish! It is short and on the body, with fine leg up, that is easy pickings. This is pulled down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Comes down the track and takes it on the full toss, he smashes it down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary.
That might have hurt! A low full toss on middle, this is hit hard back towards the bowler. It hits the foot of Chahar and rolls on the leg side to deep mid-wicket. Two taken.
WIDE! A bumper but that is way too short. Goes over the head of the batter. Smiles were exchanged between Chamika and Chahar. Always good to see that. Wided!
Does that this time! It is full and on off, Chameera walks across and tries to flick, he gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Another dot! A dipping full toss outside off, Chameera once again looks to go over the off side but no connection. Not smart from him. He should just turn the strike over to his partner.
A good slower one, well outside off. Chameera is way too early in the swing of his bat and misses.
Two! Goes full and wide again outside off, this is hit through covers for two. So despite the wicket, 8 runs from the over.
Shorter and outside off, this one stays a touch low. Karunaratne slashes at it but misses.
Another one! On off, Chameera pushes it towards covers and gets to the other end. 250 up!
On off, this is pushed towards covers for one.
FOUR! Edgy! Not a good ball with third man up in the ring, this is outside off and on a length. Karunaratne slashes at it but it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
Dushmantha Chameera walks out to bat now!

OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man and it is a welcome wicket for the visitors! A good innings by Asalanka comes to an end but his team would have loved had he batted the distance. The slower one does the trick for Kumar! It is full and on middle, Asalanka looks to heave it over the mid-wicket fence but does not connect that well and it is also towards the longer part of the ground. Devdutt Padikkal, the sub, takes a simple catch. A good batting effort nonetheless from Charith Asalanka.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Devdutt Padikkal b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Two more and the 50-run stand comes up! Goes full and on middle, Chamika tries to flick it through mid-wicket but it takes the inner edge and goes to deep square leg. No boundaries in this one, just 6 runs from it.
Just the one again! On the pads, Asalanka works it towards short fine leg for a single.
Well bowled! This is shorter and outside off. Asalanka slashes at it but misses.
Another slower one, this is fuller and on off, it is gently pushed to cover for one. Good sensible batting so far.
Another slower one, it is on middle, this is played back to the bowler. Dots are what India need right now.

That is poor from the fielder! That should have never been two! Good length and on off, this is pushed down to the long off fence. Good intensity shown by the batters and Charith Asalanka dives to make it in as the throw comes to the bowler.
Deepak Chahar is back! 6-0-35-2 are his figures so far.
Two more and despite two dots, it is a good over for the hosts! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through mid-wicket for a couple.
EDGY FOUR! Length and outside off, Asalanka throws his bat at it and the ball goes off the outside edge to the third man fence. Sri Lanka won't mind how the boundaries come as long as they come.
TWO! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard towards deep mid-wicket. Two taken.
Another dot! Sees the batter come down the track and bangs it short and outside off. Asalanka slashes at it but misses.
Fuller and on off, Asalanka pushes it to covers.
On off, this is pushed towards mid off for one.
Play and a miss! Kuldeep sends this flat and quicker through the air. It's short and outside off, Charith Asalanka tries to play the square cut but misses. A wicket-less outing for Kuldeep.
Shortish and outside off, hit through the line but straight to point.

FOUR! This is another cracking shot from the bat of Charith Asalanka. Kuldeep delivers it slower through the air, full and landing on off, Asalanka kneels down and powers his slog sweep in front of square leg.
Yet another short delivery outside off, Chamika slaps it through cover-point and rotates the strike.
Short and wide outside off, this time Charith cuts it with the spin to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Smashed away! Asalanka brings up his fifty, a fantastic knock under pressure. Kuldeep bowls it full and wide outside off, spinning away, Asalanka attacks it and flat-bats it over covers.

A dot to end then! Nicely bowled! Tosses it above the eye line outside off, this lands and turns away. Karunaratne is beaten as he tries to drive. End of Chahal for tonight and it is yet another good day with the ball for him. 10-1-50-3 for him.
Gives it a lot of flight, tempting the batter to go big but this is nicely worked on the leg side for one.
Another run as this is yet again hit to covers. Dhawan is on the edge of the ring so another easy run.
Misfield and two! Really good running! This is tossed up outside off, it is hit hard towards cover. Dhawan misfields and the batsmen get an extra run.
Another single as this is worked with the turn through mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Nice and slow! Lands it outside off, Asalanka looks to play the slog sweep but misses. Really good over by Kuldeep.
On off, this is played towards cover for one more.
Short and outside off, Asalanka cuts through covers for one.
A single now! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket to give the strike to Asalanka.
Fuller again and on off, Karunaratne pushes it to covers.
Floats it up on off, fuller. Karunaratne plays it back to the bowler.
Kuldeep Yadav (8-0-42-0) is on now!
On off, tossed up. Karunaratne plays it towards the right side of short third man for another run.
Quick run! On off, turning back in, Asalanka goes back and pushes it towards short third man. He wanted a run but his partner is late in taking off. They complete it easily though.
One more run! Outside off, Karunaratne pushes it through covers.
One more added to the total! On the pads, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Two! Swept and done so nicely, through square leg for two.
Yuzvendra Chahal is back! He has bagged three wickets so far, can he complete a fifer? Has 12 balls to do so.
Shorter and on middle, this one turns back in. Asalanka looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
A single to end! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. A really good over for Lanka.

FOUR! 200 up! Asalanka comes down the track, he does not get to the pitch of it but since it was tossed up, he goes down on one knee and heaves it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary. A quick check with the third umpire but it had fallen inside the rope.
Two more! Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Lazy fielding! On middle, Karunaratne looks to sweep but is early in the shot, it goes off the bottom edge through mid-wicket. The fielder goes after it slowly and they sneak two.
Some turn for Pandya! This lands on middle and then spins back in. Charith pushes it through covers for one.
Goes for the reverse! This lands on middle, holds its line and there is also extra bounce. Asalanka misses and gets hit high on the body.
Powerplay 3 signalled! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.

Chahar delivers this one with a short run-up, a bit short and on off, Karunaratne hits it across the line but finds the mid-wicket fielder. Superb over by Deepak Chahar, just a run and a wicket from it.
Wide! Attempts another slower one but ends up serving it down the leg side, Karunaratne tries to flick but misses.
A bumper this time, Chamika Karunaratne ducks underneath it.
Slower one again, around off, Chamika defends it back to the bowler.
Full in length and on off, Chamika pushes it down to mid on.
On a length and around off, Chamika pushes it from the back foot to the off side.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new batsman.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Chahar returns and gets a wicket. Smart beginning from him, he dishes out a slower delivery first up, drops it very full and in line of the stumps, Wanindu Hasaranga is completely fooled by the change in pace. He has played all around it, the bat comes down early while the ball arrives late and the stumps are rearranged. Deepak gets his second wicket with the knuckle-ball. Wanindu was locked inside the crease with his footwork, went nowhere and paid the price.
Deepak Chahar is back on. 1/34 in his 5 overs so far.
A little short in length and close to off, Asalanka punches it from the back foot to point.
Angles in a length ball on off, Wanindu plays it down with gentle hands in front of backward point. They steal a run.
Shortish and on off, Wanindu plays a mistimed heave towards mid on. Three dots.
Slightly short and outside off, Wanindu tries to run it down to third man but finds the fielder inside the ring.
Good length ball on off, staying down a bit, Hasaranga stays back, keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar pulls back as his handkerchief falls in his delivery stride.
MISHIT! Back of a length delivery around off, Asalanka tries to pull it over mid-wicket but it takes the top edge and falls safely behind the ball as the mid on fielder tries to get around. A single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Flighted delivery, full and around off, spinning away, Wanindu gets forward and lofts it cleanly over extra cover. No fielder in the deep and it's a safe boundary.
Slightly short and around leg, Charith goes back and drops it down in front of square leg for a brisk run.
Tossed up delivery outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Floated and full on middle, Charith Asalanka plays a cracking sweep shot to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Pitching around leg again, full in length, Asalanka once again fails to flick. He is struck on the pads, Krunal appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Slower through the air, full and around leg, Charith tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg.
A length ball on off, angling in, Hasaranga defends it back from the crease.

FOUR LEG BYES! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Hasaranga stays back to work it on the leg side but misses. It kisses his thigh pad and hurries past the diving keeper for a boundary at third man.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Charith Asalanka executes the shot as he gets bat on the ball, although it's off the outside half. A single down to third man.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Charith stays back and tries to run it down to third man but misses.
This is delivered on middle and leg, Wanindu helps it wide of short fine leg for one.
Fuller in length and outside off, Charith Asalanka tries to drive through the line but edges it down to third man for a run.
A single to end! It is a successful over for Chahal! On off, this is guided to point for a run.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Yes, it is a little too short but it was not too wide outside off. Asalanka stays leg side and slaps it through covers. This one races away to the fence.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Chahal has another one and once again, as a partnership seems to be forming, India strike! Shanaka, the skipper, walks back! The wrong shot to the wrong ball. This is the slider, it lands on middle and then skids through. Shanaka goes back and tries to play it through the off side but there is not a lot of room on offer. It sneaks through and hits the stumps.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Very full and on off, Shanaka drives it to covers. Another quick and fine over from Krunal. He breezes through his overs.
There is turn for Krunal as he slows it up around off, Shanaka tries pushing inside the line but misses.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back in the direction of the bowler.

Was there a run out chance? Tossed up ball around off, Dasun advances down the track and pushes it to the left of the cover fielder. He looks for a run but is sent back. Manish Pandey fires in a throw at the striker's end and it deflects off Shanaka's bat to fine leg. Sri Lanka decide not to take the overthrows. Good sportsman spirit shown!
Flatter and around off, Shanaka defends it back to the bowler.
Krunal Pandya is back on. 5-0-20-0 are his figures so far.
Turning down the leg side, Charith Asalanka flicks it towards square leg and crosses.
Nicely tossed up and around leg, worked to square leg for a run.
Flighted and around off, forced down to long off for a run.
FOUR! A rare bad delivery from Chahal, bowls it full and down the leg side, Shanaka goes down on one knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary.

Aerial but doesn't carry! Chahal slows it up and lands it full outside off, Charith tries to chip it over covers but it spins back in and he ends up miscuing it down to long off. Doesn't carry to Shaw. The batsmen cross.
Slower through the air, very full and on off, Charith Asalanka plays the reverse sweep but finds the fielder at backward point.
Starts with a flighted full ball on off, it's driven through wide mid off for a single.
On the fuller side, this is pushed back towards the bowler, Pandya does try to stop it with his feet but only manages to deflect it towards mid on. A single taken.
Yet another dot! Good tidy stuff from Pandya! On middle, Shanaka plays it back to the bowler.
Slightly fuller, Shanaka looks to drive but does so outside the line, it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Dark clouds have slowly started to build around the stadium. We hope that the rain stays away from this match.
On the stumps yet again. fuller this time, Shanaka pushes it to covers.
On middle, offers no space to the batter, it is worked to mid-wicket.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.

Drinks break! It's been an excellent passage of play for India after an ordinary Powerplay 1. They have succeeded in picking up wickets and have also put a lid on the scoring rate. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would be disappointed after throwing away the advantage. We have seen plenty of reckless shots from them and they have themselves to blame for this situation. 18 overs are still left in the innings and the hosts have 6 wickets in hand. Can they push their score near the 300-run mark? Hardik Pandya is getting ready to bowl after the break. He looked a bit winded after his first spell of 3 overs.
Make that 26! Shorter and outside off, this is played through point, away from the fielder in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Plays this with the turn now and works it through square leg for one more. These two are going along decently. 24 is the stand now.
Comes down the track and pushes it nicely through covers for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to the man at covers.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Misses out! This is well short and on the body, it is pulled hard but to short fine leg. A disappointed look on Asalanka's face as he knows this was there to be hit.
Two to end! On the pads, Shanaka works it fine on the leg side and takes two. A much-needed good over for Sri Lanka, 11 from it.
On off, this is now pushed through covers for one. Good batting.

FOUR! Bit of aggression from Asalanka and it comes off! This is tossed up well outside off, the length is slightly fuller and hence, Asalanka was able to drag it over mid-wicket for a welcome boundary. 150 up for his side!
Shorter again, this is played through square leg and Shanaka gets to the other end.
On middle, Asalanka works it on the leg side for one.
Really good running! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for two.

In the air... just short! A short one, gets big on the batter. Charith Asalanka looks to pull but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, it lands ahead of the fielder running in from deep mid-wicket and behind the fielder who ran back from the ring. A single.
Outside off yet again, this is pushed through covers for one more.
On off, Shanaka plays it to point.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Goes short this time, Asalanka lets it through to the keeper.
Asalanka misses out! Shorter and outside off, Charith slashes at it but misses. Wided but could have gone for a boundary had he connected.
Back of a length and on off, Asalanka rides on top of the bounce and plays it to point.
Premeditated probably! Shanaka is in a position to play the sweep early. It is the googly from Kuldeep on middle, Shanaka looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the arm.
The sweep is out again, this time he hits it well through square leg for one.
Flights it nicely and lands it on middle, Asalanka defends it onto the ground.
Another single! On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
On the pads, slower, Asalanka looks to sweep, he is a touch early into the shot. It goes off the bottom edge towards mid-wicket.

Edged but no slip in place! Fuller and around off, angling away. Asalanka pushes at it, this one goes off the outside edge down to third man for one. End of a successful over for Chahar and this should make him feel a lot better. He went for 25 runs in his first 3 overs but has come back and taken a wicket in the first over of his second spell.
A short one to welcome the new batter, Shanaka pulls it through mid-wicket and is off the mark.
This time Charith finds the middle of the bat and strokes a length ball through covers for a single.
Another flashy drive! It is full and outsied off, Asalanka goes after it, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! This is very poor, extremely poor from the Lankan batter. Yes, they probably want to play with an aggressive mindset but this is rash, especially after losing a well-set batter a few overs back. Just like before, after a stand, they have again lost two wickets in quick succession. Dhananjaya once again makes room and tries to go over extra cover. This time Chahar bowls the knuckle-ball, it is full and on off. Dhananjaya is undone completely by the lack of pace. He is way too early into the shot, his one hand comes off the handle as well. It goes up in the air and Dhawan at mid off takes a simple catch before celebrating with his trademark thigh-five.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Deepak Chahar

Commentary.Commentary: Two! Dhananjaya does not let the bowler settle down. Makes room straightaway. Chahar follows him. Dhananjaya looks to go over covers but it goes off the inner half through square leg for two.
Deepak Chahar is back on! Quite expensive in his first spell but can he drag things back here?
A dot to end but 6 from the over! Finds his length and line this time. Floats it up and lands it on off, Asalanka pushes it to covers.
Once again an easy run! On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Dhananjaya looks to flick but misses. Wided. Kuldeep really has not been at his best so far. Not hit the right lines and the lengths.
Again on the shorter side, does spin away but it is pushed through covers for one.
Slightly shorter this time, it turns back in after landing on middle, Dhananjaya works it through mid-wicket for one.
The googly, Asalanka picks it right at the end, it is worked with the turn towards square leg for one.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on. 5-0-22-0 are his figures so far.
On off, slightly fuller, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and around off, skidding away, Charith Asalanka stays back and helps it to mid-wicket. Tidy stuff from Krunal.
Flighted and full on middle, Charith flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
A bit short and skidding down the leg side, Dhananjaya works it in the gap on the leg side and crosses.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Slightly slower in pace and skidding away from the left-hander, Charith eases it wide of short third man and opens his account with a single.
Flighted and full outside off, Charith drives but fins the point fielder.
The next batsman walks in. It's Charith Asalanka.

OUT! Avishka holes out! A poor shot selection by him after getting a fifty. He is not happy with himself but will have to return. Bhuvneshwar Kumar angles in a length ball around off, Avishka camps back to heave it over the leg side but gets a top edge. Krunal Pandya smartly moves across to his right from mid on and completes the catch easily. A shot he could have easily avoided as the length was not short enough.
Commentary.Howout: c Krunal Pandya b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Shortish and on middle and leg, Dhananjaya moves back and glances it to deep square leg. Calls for two but gets only a run.
A length ball on off, Dhananjaya taps it down to point.
FOUR! Bang! Bhuvneshwar Kumar follows the batsman down the leg side with a fuller length ball, Dhananjaya still manages to find the space and drills his drive down the ground for a boundary.
Fifty for Avishka Fernando, his 4th in ODIs. Reaches there by running down a length ball to third man for a single. A chanceless knock by him so far, can he make it big?
Good length delivery on off, defended off the back foot towards point.
Skidding down the leg side, Avishka clips it to square leg and keeps strike. He is on 49!
FOUR! First boundary for Sri Lanka after the 8th over, 97 balls to be precise! Flighted delivery and outside off, Avishka lofts it over extra cover and finds the fence.
Slow spin away from the batsman, Avishka plays it down to point.
Loopy delivery, full and on off, Fernando drives it towards the cover fielder.
Slower through the air, a touch short and close to off, de Silva hangs back and strokes it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter delivery on middle, Dhananjaya walks down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Fuller and on off, Fernando tries to flick it probably but ends up defending it back towards the bowler. A dot to finish the over. India have pulled things back nicely here, only 16 runs conceded in the last 5 overs.
Delivers it on a length and outside off, Dhananjaya plays late and guides it down to third man for one.
Back of a length ball on off, Avishka keeps his weight on the back leg and heaves it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This time the line is too straight and Dhananjaya uses the angle of the bowler to work it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Another dot. Probably a slower one, on a length and close to off, holding up a bit off the surface too, de Silva gets back and pushes it to covers.
Begins a new spell with a length ball on off, Dhananjaya stays back and defends it to the off side.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns to the attack. 3-0-12-0 are his figures so far.
Fires it flat and short outside off, Avishka stays back and punches it without much timing to the cover fielder.
Another off drive, it's in the gap and a comfortable single taken as the ball goes to long off.
Quicker and fuller on off, Fernando eases his drive down to long off for another run.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Full and outside off, forced down to long off for a single.
Another one tossed up on middle, de Silva pushes it to covers.
Another one on off, slightly fuller. This one turns back in. Dhananjaya looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up on off, Fernando strokes it down to long off and takes one.
Drags his length back a little and bowls it on the stumps, Fernando plays it to mid-wicket.

Really well played and a very good running to bring the 100 up! Dhananjaya plays the paddle scoop, he uses the pace of the bowler and plays it past short fine leg, the fielder at deep backward square leg, runs to his right and slides, saves a run for his side.
Floats it up on middle, Fernando plays it with a straight bat down to long on for one.
A single to end the over! On off, this is played down to long off and a single is taken.
On middle, this is played back to the bowler again.
This one is fired into the pads, Fernando looks to push at it but misses to get hit on the pads.
A little fuller this time, it is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter and on off, the batsman has just watchfully blocked this out.
Dhananjaya steps out and Krunal shortens the length. Dhananjaya plays outside the line but it hits his pad. A muted appeal but nothing.
Flatter and quicker on middle, a bit on the shorter side as well, Avishka goes deep inside the crease, probably to pull, but ends up pushing it back to the bowler.
Quicker delivery, on middle, Fernando flicks it straight to mid-wicket where Manish Pandey picks up the ball.
Fuller in length and on off, driven down through extra cover for a run.

Very full and on middle, it's pushed down towards mid on where Pandey dives to make a superb stop to his left. Great anticipation shown by him to react from mid-wicket. The batsman who was eyeing a run has to return.
Floated again, full and close to off, Dhananjaya defends it by pressing forward.
Slower through the air, full and flighted on off, turning in a bit, Fernando leans forward and eases it down to long off for a single.
The batsman has just watchfully blocked this out. 4 from Krunal's first.
Angled into the pads, this is forced down to long on off the inner half of the blade. A single.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Fernando looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Slightly shorter in length and around off, this is worked through square leg for a run.
On middle, tossed up, this is pushed to mid on.
On middle, this one holds its line. Fernando looks to defend but this goes off the outer half towards point for one.
Krunal Pandya is on now!
Two to end! On the pads, Dhananjaya works it fine on the leg side for two.
BEATEN! That is a beautiful delivery. It lands on off and then spins away, it seems like the googly. Dhananjaya looks to defend but does so without a big stride forward, he is beaten.
This time he looks to give it air but bowls it way too full, it is pushed through covers for one.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
Half an appeal! This lands around middle and leg and turns back in. Dhananjaya looks to drive but the ball turns back in and hits the pad. Going down leg.
A little too short, this is pushed through mid-wicket for one. Kuldeep has been a touch short so far.
A dot to end! On middle, kept out.
Once again the line is a little too full and hence, it is driven through covers for one.
Attacks the stumps again, Chahal is not afraid to toss it up. Fernando pushes it to covers.
A little too full and on middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Again, slows the pace and bowls it on the stumps, Dhananjaya is solid in defense.
Nice and slow, it lands on middle, blocked.
A single to end the over as this is worked on the leg side for one.
Gets away with one! This is very short and on the pads, it is pulled hard but there is a fielder at deep square leg so only one.
This time he does get it away from the fielder at mid-wicket and pinches one.
On the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
A single! We will probably see a lot more of these now. On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.

STUMPING APPEAL! It has been referred upstairs. Have India got three wickets in the over? A lovely leg spinner from Chahal, he slows it up in the air and allows the ball to grip and spin away from around off. Avishka gets forward with a big stretch and tries to push it through the line. He fails to do so due to the turn on this ball and Ishan is quick to take the bails off. He appeals, not a very confident one but the square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the outside edge which is absent and then he finds Avishka's back leg inside the crease. The Lankan opener is safe to continue.
Another delivery on middle and leg, it's tucked behind square leg for a single.
No hat-trick! It's very full and on middle, Dhananjaya defends it on the leg side.

DRINKS! Those two wickets have shifted the balance of this match a bit in India's favour! This is almost a recap of what happened in the first ODI, the Lankans got off to a good start but the Indian spinners brought them back. Chahal has done it alone this time. Sri Lanka will have to consolidate now and the visitors will hope they can continue to chip away at the wickets. An important passage of play awaits. Dhananjaya de Silva walks out to bat now!

OUT! Caught behind! A fantastic reflex catch this time by Ishan Kishan. Chahal has two wickets in two balls now and this one is courtesy of his natural variation. Confused? What's a natural variation? Well, it's a delivery that doesn't do what it is expected to do. Chahal serves a leg spinner around off, it's intended to spin back in but instead goes straight on after landing. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans forward to defend, expecting it to be turning in but this one goes straight on, takes a thin outside edge and Ishan grabs it safely near his chest. They appeal and the finger goes up. India have come roaring back in this match!
Commentary.Howout: c Ishan Kishan b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Bhanuka Rajapaksa is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! Here is the first breakthrough for India and there is a slice of luck involved in this wicket. Chahal has bought a wicket with a full toss. Not for the first time we have seen a leg spinner getting lucky with that kind of delivery. Chahal looks up at the heavens and thanks his stars. He tosses it up around off, Minod Bhanuka advances down the track to flick it over the leg side but it takes the toe end of his bat and flies straight into the hands of Manish Pandey at short mid-wicket. This time he makes no mistake and Minod returns to the pavilion, dejected.
Commentary.Howout: c Manish Pandey b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely played! Chahal bowls it slower through the air and lands it full on off, Bhanuka goes down and paddles it quietly down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
A dot to end! This is tossed up on middle, Fernando looks to push at it, it goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Comes down the track again and works it down to long on for one.
Close! This is just outside off, Minod leaves it alone. Goes just past the off pole.
On off, this is pushed towards covers for one.
A single again as this is eased down to long on.
Steps down and takes it on the full, it is worked wide of the long on fielder for two.
Spin from the other end too now as Kuldeep Yadav is on! Hardik Pandya was seen struggling after completing his last over, not sure whether it's the heat taking a toll or some injury.
A single now! On middle, this is worked on the leg side to deep mid-wicket for one. So a decent passage for India. They have kept it nice and right in the recent overs.
A lot of turn again but too high! This lands outside off and then spins back in sharply. Bhanuka looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads. An appeal but turned down.
Tossed up on off, Fernando strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
That spun big! It is a lot slower, it lands on middle and then spins away sharply. Fernando looks to defend but it beats the outside edge and goes past the bat to the keeper.
Flatter and on off, Bhanuka works it through mid-wicket for one.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Wide, not given! This is full and down the leg side, Minod looks to flick but misses. Not sure why that was not given as a wide.
Outside off, this time he does get it through the in-field on the off side, towards deep cover, for one.
Three dots in a row now as this is once again played to the man at covers.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed again to covers.
Back of a length and on off, Fernando pushes it to covers.

FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Nothing Ishan could have done there! A short one and on middle, a tennis ball like bounce on this one. Goes way over the batter's head and over the keeper as well for a boundary.
WIDE! A good short one but down the leg side, Fernando looks to pull but misses.
On middle, blocked.
Powerplay 2 signalled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

The googly to end, Minod does not pick it, he looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point. Another tidy over for India, 6 runs in the last two to complete Powerplay 1. A good one for Sri Lanka though as they are 59 for no loss.
Floats it up on middle, kept out.
A little too straight, Bhanuka looks to flick but misses. It goes off the pads and towards fine leg for two as Kuldeep Yadav chases it down. Leg byes signalled.
Yet another dot! On middle, this is once again worked with the turn to mid-wicket for no runs.
Very well bowled! Slows it up and lands it on middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, this is defended.
Once again a dot to end the over. On middle, blocked. So, end of a rare over where a boundary is not scored.
Attacks the stumps, Fernando hangs back and works it to mid-wicket.
Good rotation of strike! On the pads yet again, Bhanuka clips it towards deep square leg and gets to the other end.
Another single! On the pads, Fernando flicks it through square leg and gets to the other end.
A single! On the shorter side, this is worked on the leg side towards square leg for one.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, left alone. Another extra.
Drop and run! Minod looks to play this towards point with soft hands and steal a run but is sent back.

Did you know? India have the worst bowling average in ODIs in Powerplay 1 since 2020 - 123.5 (before this match). It's once again on display here as they struggle for an early breakthrough. Not to forget the dropped catch though.
On middle, defended. A dot to end but the damage was done earlier in the over.
A little bit of turn! This lands on middle and then spins away, Fernando looks to work it on the leg side but this goes off a soft leading edge to covers.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over. So despite the change in bowling, the runs continue to flow! On the pads, Fernando works it fine on the leg side and this one races away to the fence. Fifty up for Lanka and this is the perfect start for them, the openers have laid the foundation for a good score.

SAFE! That is just not needed. Having got a boundary on the last ball, this is rash. Smart from Chahal! Slows it up and bowls it wide outside off, making the batter drag it, Minod does try to do so with a slog sweep but it goes off the top edge, high up in the air towards mid on. Pandey from mid-wicket runs there but has no chance. A single taken.
FOUR! Lovely use of the feet and all of a sudden Minod is striking at over a run-a-ball! He steps out and gets to the pitch of the ball, lofts it over mid off for a boundary.

Starts off really well, it lands on off and just turns back in a little. A leg spinner but bowled quicker. Minod goes back to a ball he should be coming forward to, he though gets an inside edge onto the pads as he tries to block.

Time for some spin now! This is where the game changed in the first ODI, after the introduction of Chahal and he comes on now. Can he provide the goods again? He got some good turn in the first game and it will be interesting to see if he gets some here.
A decent comeback then from Pandya after going for 5 from his first ball! On middle, this is nudged through square leg for one.
Easy! This time, lets the ball come to him and then works it on the leg side for one.
Well bowled! Squares the batter a little! Length and on middle, this one pitches and once again holds its line. Fernando is squared up as he tries to block but does it well.
Another good length delivery, this time the ball holds its line just a little. Fernando opens the face of the bat and plays it to point.
Goes back to bowling it on a length and around off, Fernando guides it to point.

FOUR! This time Fernando makes him pay! Pandya goes short, this is his go-to ball but Avishka was ready for it, he hammers it over mid-wicket for another boundary for Sri Lanka in a short span of time.
Starts off right on the money! Length and on middle, defended. Good start by Pandya. Not a good one actually as he has overstepped. Another Free Hit for Lanka.
Hardik Pandya is on now, sporting a lovely bandana! A change was imminent as runs were flowing.
A short one to end, not a lot of pace on it, evaded. Runs flowing now for the hosts. 30 runs in the last three overs!
Drags his length back and bowls it on off, Bhanuka blocks it.

FOUR! Raining boundaries at the moment from the bat of Minod. Another beautiful stroke! Yes, it is a half volley but it still has to be put away. Full and on off, this is driven with a straight bat down the ground and it goes to the long off fence. This is a superb start for the Lankans and the pitch looks a belter to bat on.

FOUR! Binod is now oozing confidence! He is not only started to find the middle but also the gaps. The outfield is also really quick! Slightly shorter and on middle, Binod picks the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket, no chance of stopping that one as it races through mid-wicket.
Takes pace off the ball this time and bowls it fuller and on middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
Solid! Length and on off, Fernando pushes it to covers.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over and this is even better than the last one. One of the hardest shots to play in the game, the on-drive. It is full and on middle, this is creamed through mid on for another boundary. A good over for Sri Lanka. Back-to-back good overs for them. It actually was not timed that well, the bat shook in his hand but since mid on was quite wide, a boundary results.
Gets it right this time! Lands it on a length and on off, blocked onto the ground.

FOUR! Errs in line and pays the price! This is full and a little too straight, Minod takes full toll of it as he whips it over square leg, no one in the deep and this should make Binod feel a lot better. He wanted to get one away and has finally got the boundary that should release the pressure building on him.
Again! Offering no width, not letting the batter free his arms. It is played to the man at mid-wicket again.
Back of a length and on middle, cramps the batter for room. It is worked to mid-wicket.
Gets away with it! Bowls a good slower one outside off. Minod looks to go over the leg side, he tried to drag it, should have tried to go over covers. Misses.

A little bit of movement after the ball pitches but the line is down the leg side. Minod looks to flick but misses. Wided. Hang on a second, it is not a wide but instead a NO BALL! It is the first Bhuvneshwar Kumar has bowled since 2015. 3093 balls before overstepping, he is human after all. Free Hit coming up.
Good length delivery angling in from around off, Avishka defends it towards mid on to complete an eventful over, 12 runs off it.
On a length and outside off, Fernando goes hard at it and gets it away off the inside edge. The ball rolls through square leg, they push hard and get two runs.
Good length ball on middle, Avishka once again forces it down to mid on but not in the gap.
Fuller and on middle, Avishka pushes it off his pads to mid on.

SIX! Bhuvneshwar Kumar has completely misjudged it, he ran in a bit too much. A length delivery again, this time angling down the leg side, Fernando picks it off his pads and flicks it aerially towards long leg. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is stationed there and he charges in from the deep, misjudges badly as the ball goes over his head. His attempt to catch it with a jump fails and to add insult to injury, it has fallen beyond the boundary line.
FOUR! Great shot! A length delivery in the channel outside off, Fernando takes his front leg forward and cracks it through the gap between mid off and extra cover.
A touch short and on middle, Minod goes on his toes and keeps it out safely on the leg side.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Minod pushes it defensively off his back foot to cover-point.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Fernando punches it past the bowler and takes a single as the mid on fielder cuts it off.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it from the crease.
Good length ball outside off, it's left alone by Avishka.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

EDGED BUT SAFE! This time it has not carried to second slip. A better line from Chahar on this occasion. He keeps it close to off and gets it to move away off the seam, Bhanuka tries to defend with firm hands but edges it behind. Manish reacts quickly but it falls short of him. Wait for a second, the replays show that it did carry and Pandey has failed to grab it. He attempted it with his right hand, probably a shade late as he thought maybe Prithvi will also go for it from first slip. A lifeline for Minod Bhanuka.

FOUR! First of the game! Chahar gets greedy, tries to bowl an outswinger from the leg stump line, but it turns out to be very straight in line and Bhanuka flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary. Opens his account.
Fullish and on off, Bhanuka drives it down the ground but straight to mid off.
Flashes and misses! Chahar puts it on a length and outside off, angling away, the length is not short to attempt a back foot cut but Minod still tries and gets beaten.
Pitches it up and outside off, Bhanuka drives it off his front foot but finds the cover fielder. Misses out there, all he needed was to put it in the gap.
There is a hint of away movement. Deepak delivers it on a good length outside off, Minod makes a watchful leave.
Deepak Chahar to bowl from the other end. Two slips in place.
There is the inswinger. On a length and around off, Fernando goes back and defends it back safely. Top over by Bhuvneshwar Kumar!
Serves a good length delivery outside off, nipping away, Avishka Fernando covers his stumps and shoulders arms.

EDGED BUT JUST WIDE OF SECOND SLIP! A nervy moment for Avishka Fernando. He once again has a gentle poke inside the line of a length delivery outside off and the away movement takes the outside edge. Manish Pandey dives full length to his right but it goes wide and runs down to third man for a couple of runs.
Good length ball outside off, shaping away, Avishka defends it off his back foot to the off side.

Kumar was operating with one slip but now one more comes in after the last delivery. Bhuvneshwar Kumar serves it on a length and outside off, once again Fernando stays back and defends it from the bottom half of his bat.
Beautiful delivery! Kumar hurls it on a length close to off, Avishka tries to defend without any footwork but it nips away to beat the outside edge. A lovely presentation of the seam.

It's time to get underway! Avishka Fernando and Minod Bhanuka are the Sri Lankan openers. It's very warm and humid out there. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is marking his run-up as he will bowl first with the first new ball. All in readiness, let's crack it...

India (Unchanged Playing XI) -  Prithvi Shaw, Shikhar Dhawan (C), Ishan Kishan (WK), Manish Pandey, Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya, Krunal Pandya, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Deepak Chahar, Kuldeep Yadav, Yuzvendra Chahal.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Minod Bhanuka (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Kasun Rajitha (In for Isuru Udana), Dushmantha Chameera.

Shikhar Dhawan, the Indian skipper, starts by saying that it was a great job from the bowlers in the last game to restrict Sri Lanka. Praises his spinners for doing a good job while bowling in tandem. Regarding his own batting, Dhawan replies that it depends on the situation and he just looked to rotate the strike as the other batsmen were striking so well. Informs that INDIA ARE UNCHANGED!

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka, says that the pitch looks better than the last match and batting first would be the way to go. He feels that their batting did well in the end overs of the last game but they need to bat better in the middle overs. Informs that Kasun Rajitha is replacing Isuru Udana in the XI.
Both the captains are out in the middle. Dasun Shanaka has the coin and he gives it a good toss. Shikhar Dhawan calls TAILS but it's HEADS. SRI LANKA ELECT TO BAT!

One of the heroes of the first ODI, Suryakumar Yadav is up for a chat! Regarding his batting, Yadav says that he has been doing the same role in the last few years and that wasn't something new. Adds that passion for this game kept him going and his dad always told him to keep working hard and have patience. States that it was a very emotional moment (to receive the ODI cap) and the only regret is that his family is not around due to the existing situation but back home they were really happy and excited. On his bowling, he replies that he has been bowling in the nets and whenever opportunity strikes, he will be ready. On his preferred batting position, SKY tells that he is comfortable at going in any position. Shares that the feeling in the squad is positive and the brand of cricket they are playing is great and they just want to carry that momentum.

A team going through a crisis faced a team with an abundance of wealth in terms of quality players and the end result was something that was already known - A thorough thrashing! The first match of the series showed two things very clearly, one is that young India is very hungry and the second is that Sri Lanka's never-ending transition period has pushed them way back in the pecking order. A wide gulf between these two teams means that we are in for yet another one-sided affair. Can Sri Lanka have it in them to prove us wrong? Hello and a warm welcome to everyone for the second ODI of the series and thank you for joining us for the coverage. Stay tuned for more updates...
